title: Leap Year
description:
Return `True` if the given year is a leap year, `False` otherwise. A leap year is divisible by 4, EXCEPT century years (divisible by 100) must also be divisible by 400.

**Example:**
```
is_leap_year(2000) → True
is_leap_year(1900) → False
is_leap_year(2024) → True
is_leap_year(2023) → False
```
hint: A year is a leap year if (year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0) or (year % 400 == 0).
